scraped.scraped_description: Security First develops Umbrella, a free open source digital and physical security handbook app for journalists, activists, NGO staff, and people working in high-risk environments.

name: Security First / Umbrella
tagline: Free, open source digital and physical security handbook app for journalists, activists, NGO staff, and people working in high-risk environments.
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 - Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions

Security First training materials integrated into digital security curricula by international NGOs and press freedom organizations working with at-risk journalists
